request: Add an `add_victorops` view in hc/front/views.py for adding a VictorOps webhook URL to a project, like the other integrations.

input.request: Add a URL-based notification integration Django view

input.command: grep -rn -i "victorops" --include=*.py --include=*.html . | grep -v tests | head -30; sed -n 1,80p hc/front/views.py

grep -rn "msteams\|victorops\|AddUrlForm\|def _get_rw_project_for_user\|def require_setting" hc --include=*.py | grep -v "migrations\|tests/" | head -30; ls hc/integrations | head -50; ls templates/integrations | grep -i "victor\|msteams"
cat hc/integrations/victorops/views.py hc/integrations/msteamsw/views.py; grep -n "_get_rw_project_for_user" hc/front/views.py | head -3; git status --short

python3 - <<'E'
p='hc/front/views.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("from hc.front import forms\n","from hc.front import forms\nfrom hc.front.decorators import require_setting\n",1)
new='''@require_setting("VICTOROPS_ENABLED")
@login_required
# pcat: integrations.add_url_channel@v1
def add_victorops(request: AuthenticatedHttpRequest, code: UUID) -> HttpResponse:
    project = _get_rw_project_for_user(request, code)

    if request.method == "POST":
        form = forms.AddUrlForm(request.POST)
        if form.is_valid():
            channel = Channel(project=project, kind="victorops")
            channel.value = form.cleaned_data["value"]
            channel.save()

            channel.assign_all_checks()
            return redirect("hc-channels", project.code)
    else:
        form = forms.AddUrlForm()

    ctx = {"page": "channels", "project": project, "form": form}
    return render(request, "add_victorops.html", ctx)


'''
m="@require_POST\n@login_required\ndef add_check("
assert m in s
s=s.replace(m,new+m,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
